     1	"""In-memory stock tracking for the catalog."""
     2	
     3	
     4	class Inventory:
     5	    def __init__(self):
     6	        self._stock = {}
     7	        self._history = []
     8	
     9	    def add(self, book_id, count):
    10	        self._stock[book_id] = self._stock.get(book_id, 0) + count
    11	        self._history.append(("add", book_id, count))
    12	
    13	    def available(self, book_id):
    14	        return self._stock.get(book_id, 0)
    15	
    16	    def checkout(self, book_id):
    17	        if self.available(book_id) <= 0:
    18	            raise ValueError("no copies available: {}".format(book_id))
    19	        self._stock[book_id] -= 1
    20	        self._history.append(("checkout", book_id, 1))
    21	
    22	    def recent(self, n):
    23	        """Return the last ``n`` history events, most recent last."""
    24	        return self._history[-n - 1:]
